name: PII Safe Documents (danyuchn/pii-guard)
category_title_en: What can I feed to AI?

why_chosen_en: Provides an explicit risk-scoring rubric that targets version-specific claims, obscure dates, and exact URLs, preventing propagation of confident falsehoods.
why_chosen_cn: 提供断言级风险量表，排查易错的版本号、历史时间点与外部链接，标注缺乏依据的表述。

status.adoption: 开源 Agent Skills 规范目录 (经本地实测)

status.trust_source_cn: 代码开源，基于概率性归纳反思逻辑，经多款客户端测试验证，可识别语义滑移与无根据扩写内容。
status.trust_source_en: Open and transparent codebase; utilizes inductive verification logic tested across clients to catch semantic drift.

target_persona: Knowledge Workers, Editors, Content Teams, Researchers
summary_en: Performs claim-level hallucination-risk triage, scrutinizing citations, URLs, quotes, and version-specific assertions against an explicit consequence rubric.
summary_cn: 执行断言级幻觉风险分级排查，对具体引文、URL、直接引语及专业领域断言进行针对性审查并评估其可靠度。
why_care_cn: AI 生成的长文常在局部夹杂细微的事实错误。该技能扮演审核员角色，逐段标注缺乏确凿根据的表述并提示用户复查。
why_care_en: AI prose always looks fluent and plausible. This reviewer scores text for hallucination risk and flags unsupported assertions.
how_to_use_cn: 文章完成后调用该技能，系统标出文中存疑、缺乏来源或断言过于绝对的句子供人工复核。
how_to_use_en: Call the reviewer after drafting to get an annotated copy highlighting statements with high hallucination likelihood.

standard_alignment.how_aligned_en: Employs ACM survey methodology measuring uncertainty tokens and fact-bearing density to assess hallucination risks.

name: Vectara Hallucination Corrector HHEM (vectara)
category_title_en: Which answers can I trust?
timing_desc_en: Automated verification: Evaluates factual consistency against source documents and algorithmically strips ungrounded claims.
timing_desc_cn: 检索后一致性校正：根据检索源文档评估生成内容的事实一致性，剔除无根据断言。
why_chosen_en: Utilizes Vectara's industry-standard HHEM (Hughes Hallucination Evaluation Model). It never invents missing facts—it strictly removes or hedges unsupported claims.
why_chosen_cn: 依托业界广泛采用的 Vectara HHEM 事实评估基准，对缺乏证据支持的断言进行删减或对冲处理，不强行编造细节。

status.adoption: Vectara 商业级 HHEM 幻觉评测基准
status.adoption_cn: ⭐ 工业级基准 (Vectara HHEM 官方)

status.trust_source_cn: 由大模型幻觉排行榜 Vectara 官方团队研发，基于 HuggingFace 上的 HHEM 评估模型构建，测试数据公开。
status.trust_source_en: Developed by Vectara, authors of the industry-standard HHEM hallucination leaderboard on HuggingFace.

summary_en: Evaluates factual consistency of generated text against source documents using HHEM, stripping ungrounded claims rather than guessing.
summary_cn: 通过 Vectara HHEM 事实一致性模型比对生成文本与源文档，删除或修正缺乏实证依据的幻觉断言。
why_care_cn: 在基于文档回答问题（RAG）时，模型可能掺杂外部幻觉。该技能通过算法比对回答与原始文档，指出偏离原文的句子。
why_care_en: Utilizes Vectara’s proven HHEM evaluation model to mathematically score and correct factual drift against reference materials.
how_to_use_cn: 安装后，当模型基于上传资料作答时，技能会自动计算文本一致性得分并提示修正有出入的内容。
how_to_use_en: Install into agent client. Automatically compares generated summaries against provided context documents to score faithfulness.

standard_alignment.name_zh: Vectara Hughes 幻觉评估模型 (HHEM) 全球事实一致性基准
standard_alignment.name_en: Vectara Hughes Hallucination Evaluation Model (HHEM) Leaderboard & Benchmark
standard_alignment.how_aligned_zh: 依据 Vectara HHEM 事实一致性分类器标准，在 RAG 场景下对生成文本与检索上下文进行一致性校验。
standard_alignment.how_aligned_en: Directly integrates the industry-standard HHEM benchmark to detect and correct factual drift in real time.

name: K-Dense Scientific Peer Review (K-Dense-AI)
category_title_en: Which answers can I trust?
timing_desc_en: Reasoning audit: Run on scientific proposals, experimental methodology, and statistical inferences.
timing_desc_cn: 推演论证审计：审校科学实验方案、统计分析或复杂推论过程时介入。
why_chosen_en: Brings academic peer-review scrutiny to complex analytical reasoning, testing whether mathematical derivations and empirical conclusions legitimately follow from stated premises.
why_chosen_cn: 将学术同行评审规范引入复杂分析中，检查数学推导与实验推论链是否存在逻辑漏洞或跳步。

status.adoption: K-Dense 科学智能体评审体系 (经本地实测)

status.trust_source_cn: 源自专注于科研智能体的 K-Dense 团队，依据同行评审双盲指南构建，已完成学术论文审稿用例测试。
status.trust_source_en: Engineered by scientific agent specialist team K-Dense-AI, modeled after top-tier journal double-blind peer reviews.

summary_en: Performs rigorous academic peer-review verification on scientific drafts, validating logical derivation steps and empirical conclusions.
summary_cn: 对科学与学术草稿执行同行评审流程核验，交叉检验数学推导过程与实证推论的逻辑自洽性。
why_care_cn: 在评估技术方案或数据分析时，表面合理的推理可能掩盖了关键漏洞。该技能按照同行评审的核验清单提出质疑，提示补充必要证据。
why_care_en: Brings scientific peer review rigor to everyday documents, exposing pseudo-scientific claims and methodological flaws.
how_to_use_cn: 完成研究提案或分析报告后调用，技能会列出方案中的薄弱环节与需要补强的论据清单。
how_to_use_en: Invoke on research proposals to receive structured peer-review feedback identifying weak evidence and logical gaps.

standard_alignment.name_zh: 《自然·机器智能》关于人工智能辅助同行评审的质量与伦理规范
standard_alignment.name_en: Nature Machine Intelligence: Ethical Standards in AI-Assisted Peer Review
standard_alignment.how_aligned_zh: 参照《自然·机器智能》关于 AI 辅助结构与方法审查的伦理准则，将同行评审形式要求转化为标准化审查步骤。
standard_alignment.how_aligned_en: Adheres to Nature Machine Intelligence ethics ensuring AI serves as a methodological sanity check while human peer review remains sovereign.

name: The Judge (tech-leads-club/agent-skills)
category_title_en: Which answers can I trust?
timing_desc_en: Post-draft adjudication: Enforces "Evidence or silence" before any technical or factual recommendation is accepted.
timing_desc_cn: 结论审查时：在采纳任何事实断言或技术结论前执行严格证据核验，无确凿记录时明确说明。
why_chosen_en: Enforces the non-negotiable rule "Evidence or silence": every internal claim requires file:line proof; every external claim requires an official live URL.
why_chosen_cn: 落实“无证据即保持沉默”原则（Evidence or silence），要求每一项技术推论必须出示具体依据，不凭模型记忆作答。

status.adoption: GitHub 6.6k★ (Tech Leads Club)
status.trust_source: 源自 Tech Leads Club 工程质量套件，执行“出示直接证据或保持沉默”规则，抑制模型的推测性发言。
status.trust_source_cn: 源自 Tech Leads Club 工程质量套件，执行“出示直接证据或保持沉默”规则，抑制模型的推测性发言。
status.trust_source_en: From Tech Leads Club (6.6k★) quality suite. Enforces 'direct proof or silence' rule, preventing speculative hallucinations.

summary_en: Evidence-first adjudication skill enforcing "Evidence or silence" — claims without verified file citations or live official URLs are rejected.
summary_cn: 事实裁决规则：要求每条结论必须提供代码行号或官方文档链接证据，拒绝未经证实的猜想。
why_care_cn: 大模型容易根据模糊概率给出看似笃定但无从考据的回答。The Judge 要求每条结论必须指出明确的代码行号或官方链接，找不到时如实承认。
why_care_en: The most dangerous AI trap is confident hallucination. The Judge enforces the courtroom rule: silence without hard evidence; every claim must cite verifiable sources.
how_to_use_cn: 提示模型“按照 The Judge 规则审查当前输出”，模型将补充各结论的事实来源，或撤回未经验证的猜想。
how_to_use_en: Direct the agent to review output using The Judge protocol; all claims without verifiable official proof are pruned automatically.

standard_alignment.name_zh: 马丁·福勒 (Martin Fowler) 实证驱动软件架构评审准则
standard_alignment.name_en: Martin Fowler: Evidence-Driven Architecture & Verification Gates
standard_alignment.how_aligned_zh: 贯彻“无确凿证据即保持沉默”的工程准则，对没有直接命令输出或代码依据的主观技术推论判定为未通过。
standard_alignment.how_aligned_en: Reflects foundational software engineering principles where technical decisions must be backed by verifiable evidence.

name: The Fool (tech-leads-club/agent-skills)
category_title_en: When should I NOT listen to AI?
timing_desc_en: Decision challenge: Triggered whenever the user is tempted to quickly adopt an AI plan or strategy.
timing_desc_cn: 方案反思时：在倾向于快速采纳 AI 规划或策略前调用，辅助排查思维盲区。
why_chosen_en: Explicity designed NOT to make decisions, but to shatter premature consensus through pre-mortems, assumption probing, and cognitive-bias scans.
why_chosen_cn: 设计原则为“不替人类做决定，负责指出薄弱点”。通过事前反思、隐性假设梳理与偏差扫描，帮助用户发现未考虑到的情况。

status.adoption: GitHub 6.6k★ (Tech Leads Club)
status.trust_source: 源自 Tech Leads Club，基于打破群体思维的设计思路开发，已被用于日常敏捷架构评审。
status.trust_source_cn: 源自 Tech Leads Club，基于打破群体思维的设计思路开发，已被用于日常敏捷架构评审。
status.trust_source_en: From Tech Leads Club (6.6k★). Inspired by the Court Jester archetype to pierce consensus bias; widely adopted in architecture reviews.

summary_en: Acts as a deliberate devil's advocate that probes hidden assumptions, dialectical counterarguments, and failure modes to shatter premature consensus.
summary_cn: 扮演挑剔的反思者，专门探测隐性假设、进行事前反思与认知偏差扫描，排查方案中的潜在问题。
why_care_cn: 大模型常有顺从用户偏好的倾向，即使你的前提出错，它也往往附和作答。该技能主动扮演反对立场，指出方案中被忽略的假设漏洞。
why_care_en: LLMs are chronic people-pleasers that validate bad ideas. "The Fool" breaks sycophancy by bluntly exposing your blind spots.
how_to_use_cn: 在确定商业方案或系统设计前调用，要求模型跳出顺从模式，集中列出方案中存疑的前提假设。
how_to_use_en: Activate during strategic brainstorming. The agent ceases agreeable validation and attacks your proposal’s weakest assumptions.

standard_alignment.name_zh: 卡尼曼《思考，快与慢》双系统认知偏差防御与苏格拉底反诘法
standard_alignment.name_en: Daniel Kahneman: Dual-Process Cognitive Bias Defense & Socratic Dialectics
standard_alignment.how_aligned_zh: 参照卡尼曼对抗认知偏误的“慢思考”方法，针对用户方案中的隐含假设展开质询，指出容易被忽略的边界条件。
standard_alignment.how_aligned_en: Forces deliberate 'System 2' friction into AI discussions, countering conversational confirmation bias.

name: Sycophancy Challenger (mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills)
category_title_en: When should I NOT listen to AI?
timing_desc_en: Iterative debate: Enforces anti-appeasement rules whenever you feel the AI is being too agreeable.
timing_desc_cn: 方案推敲时：在模型表现出过度附和、缺乏实质批判时开启对抗模式。
why_chosen_en: Directly cures the pervasive AI sycophancy flaw. Enforces strict anti-appeasement rules: forbids the agent from retreating from a critique merely because the user pushes back.
why_chosen_cn: 针对大模型普遍存在的迎合倾向（Sycophancy），设定反顺从规则：除非用户提供确凿事实，否则不应为礼貌而放弃质疑立场。

status.adoption: 产品工程开源技能库 (经本地实测)
status.trust_source: 针对模型迎合倾向设计，经多组包含偏见假设的提示词测试，能够保持相对客观的批评立场。
status.trust_source_cn: 针对模型迎合倾向设计，经多组包含偏见假设的提示词测试，能够保持相对客观的批评立场。
status.trust_source_en: Specifically tackles model sycophancy bias. Verified against 15+ deliberate user-leading traps to preserve impartial reasoning.

summary_en: Flips the assistant into adversarial mode, forbidding it from softening critiques unless the user provides fresh, dispositive evidence.
summary_cn: 将模型切换至批判审查模式，要求针对当前论点提出反例与替代视角，避免无原则附和用户假设。
why_care_cn: 模型附和你的观点并不代表论点本身没有漏洞。该技能阻断模型的讨好倾向，强制其列出反驳证据与潜在反对意见，辅助独立思考。
why_care_en: Users mistake AI agreement for objective validation. This challenger forces the model to construct contrary arguments.
how_to_use_cn: 在 Claude Code 或 Cursor 中安装后，陈述方案并要求模型展开反向质疑，列出潜在反例。
how_to_use_en: Install into your workspace. Instruct the agent to challenge your perspective with empirical counterexamples.

standard_alignment.name_zh: Anthropic 官方研究：大语言模型阿谀奉承（Sycophancy）偏见的实证防御准则
standard_alignment.name_en: Anthropic Research: Towards Understanding Sycophancy in Language Models
standard_alignment.how_aligned_zh: 针对研究中发现的模型因迎合用户而赞同错误假设的问题，建立前置反迎合规则，强制优先列出潜在弱点。
standard_alignment.how_aligned_en: Groundbreaking Anthropic study proving RLHF models habitually flatter user misconceptions; this skill acts as the direct antidote.

name: jihlenburg/mad-skills (devils-advocate)
category_title_en: When should I NOT listen to AI?
timing_desc_en: Stress testing: Spawns an adversarial sub-agent to stress-test proposals across 8 failure modes.
timing_desc_cn: 压力测试：在方案定稿前启动对抗性子智能体，从 8 个不同失败维度进行压力测试。
why_chosen_en: Offers systematic failure-mode testing across eight distinct vectors, preventing users from walking into predictable operational traps.
why_chosen_cn: 提供涵盖 8 个维度的失败模式分析，防止用户陷入单一视角，提前标出潜在的执行障碍。

status.trust_source_cn: 参考多智能体辩论（Multi-Agent Debate）模式开发，纯本地指令执行，已在架构评审中完成有效性测试。

summary_cn: 启动对抗性子智能体，在方案定稿前从 8 个潜在失败维度进行系统化压力测试与风险评级。
why_care_cn: 在评估代码架构与方案时，容易低估实际运行中的边缘异常。该技能让模型假设方案在生产环境中遭遇失败，并倒推最可能的原因。
why_care_en: Overcomes automation bias in programming and writing by performing a pre-mortem on proposed solutions.
how_to_use_cn: 在采纳技术方案前运行，智能体将进行事前推演（Pre-mortem），列出潜在故障点与应对建议。
how_to_use_en: Run before accepting architectural designs to simulate catastrophic edge cases and concurrency bugs.

standard_alignment.name_zh: 多智能体对抗辩论 (Multi-Agent Debate) 发散性思辨技术规范
standard_alignment.name_en: Encouraging Divergent Thinking in LLMs via Multi-Agent Debate
standard_alignment.how_aligned_zh: 遵循多智能体对抗辩论方法，将任务拆分为立论与驳论两个相互检验的角色，防止单模型输出思维狭窄。
standard_alignment.how_aligned_en: Applies proven multi-agent debate methodology using adversarial roles to prevent uncritical agreement.

name: Godfly Opposing Counsel (CassioRoos/godfly-skills)
category_title_en: When should I NOT listen to AI?
timing_desc_en: Irreversible decisions: Generates an Opposing Brief attacking load-bearing assumptions for high-stakes commitments.
timing_desc_cn: 决策关口：针对重大商业合同或方案定稿，生成反对方立场的质询书。
why_chosen_en: Avoids performative contrarianism. Produces a formal Opposing Brief that explicitly names the irreversible costs of the chosen path and outlines how the alternative strategy would fundamentally win.
why_chosen_cn: 避免流于表面的反驳，生成结构化的反对方质询意见：测算当前路径的试错代价，明确在何种条件下备选方案更具优势。

status.trust_source_cn: 借鉴法庭对抗性交叉质询逻辑开发，代码完全开源，已通过方案对抗性压力测试。
status.trust_source_en: Built on common-law cross-examination procedures. Open code, validated through adversarial scenario stress testing.

summary_cn: 模拟对抗方立场起草质询意见，检验核心前提，测算调整成本，指出方案可能面临的质疑点。
why_care_cn: 撰写申诉文书或谈判要点时容易只考虑自身利益。该技能模拟对方立场的法务或对手，指出文书中的事实软肋，帮助完善论据。

how_to_use_cn: 起草诉求书或谈判策略后运行，模型将以反方立场挑出证据链中的薄弱环节。
how_to_use_en: Run against negotiation drafts. The agent analyzes your prose from an adversary’s stance to spot legal and evidential weaknesses.

timing_desc_cn: 答辩前测试：在论文投稿或答辩前，对研究方法与理论根基执行压力测试。

status.trust_source_cn: 面向学术严谨性审查开发，专注指出推导漏洞与未经证明的前提，已通过论文初稿测试验证。

name: The Jury (tech-leads-club/agent-skills)

why_chosen_cn: 结合多智能体决策机制，通过匿名评审与少数派异见保留机制，减少单一模型盲目迎合用户的现象。

how_to_use_cn: 输入“请陪审团审议该方案”，模型通过多轮独立审议，输出包含置信度与未决异议的总结意见。
how_to_use_en: Prompt "Convene a jury to deliberate on this plan" to trigger multi-perspective blind evaluation and committed verdict generation.

standard_alignment.how_aligned_en: Mathematical foundation of collective intelligence proving independent anonymous jurors drastically outperform any single oracle.

how_to_use_en: Run the skill against any HTML or frontend component to automatically audit contrast, missing alt texts, and ARIA attributes with instant drop-in fixes.

standard_alignment.name_zh: 万维网联盟 (W3C) Web 内容无障碍指南国际标准 (WCAG 2.1 Level AA / ISO/IEC 40500:2012)
standard_alignment.name_en: W3C Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG 2.1 AA / ISO/IEC 40500:2012)
standard_alignment.how_aligned_zh: 落实 W3C WCAG 2.1 AA 级无障碍原则（可感知、可操作、可理解与健壮性），在上线前核查屏幕阅读器标签、焦点控制与色彩对比度。
standard_alignment.how_aligned_en: Implements W3C WCAG 2.1 AA (POUR) criteria across generated frontend code, validating ARIA tags, contrast ratios, and screen-reader compatibility.

why_chosen_en: Directly blocks AI from accidentally baking API tokens, private keys, and critical CVEs into output patches. Integrates industry-standard Gitleaks secret scanning and OWASP vulnerability analysis.
why_chosen_cn: 防范模型在代码中直接硬编码 API 密钥、数据库连接串或引入已知漏洞。结合 Gitleaks 对代码差异进行扫描，避免敏感信息意外提交。

status.trust_source_cn: 由区块链安全机构 Consensys 官方安全团队开源维护，集成 Gitleaks 规则库与 Diff 扫描机制，经实际代码提交测试验证。
status.trust_source_en: Maintained by the cybersecurity team at Consensys; integrates Gitleaks secret pattern recognition to prevent credential leakage.

target_persona: Software Developers, Security Engineers, DevOps Teams
summary_en: Orchestrates multi-phase security review including Gitleaks secret scanning and OWASP vulnerability detection before code is merged or published.
summary_cn: 在智能体生成的代码或补丁发布前，集成 Gitleaks 密钥检测与常见代码漏洞分析，拦截敏感凭证外泄。
why_care_cn: 在请 AI 编写脚本时，模型有时会将你刚提供的 API Key 或密码直接写死在代码中。若随代码一起推送到公开代码库，容易造成凭据泄漏。该技能在提交前扫描代码，拦截所有明文密钥。
why_care_en: Autonomous coding agents frequently hardcode private API tokens, AWS keys, or passwords into generated code files. This skill inspects outgoing diffs using Gitleaks to block secret exposure before release.
how_to_use_cn: 在准备提交或发布代码前运行安全审查指令，技能调用 Gitleaks 与检测规则分析代码改动，汇报潜在的凭证泄漏项。
how_to_use_en: Trigger the security review on your PR or diff. The agent uses Gitleaks to sweep for exposed tokens and flags OWASP vulnerabilities with remediation steps.

standard_alignment.name_zh: OWASP Top 10 应用程序安全风险标准与 Gitleaks 敏感凭证检测规范
standard_alignment.name_en: OWASP Top 10 Application Security Risks & Gitleaks Secret Detection Framework
standard_alignment.how_aligned_zh: 结合 OWASP Top 10 漏洞审计规范与 Gitleaks 凭据规则库，对生成的代码补丁执行自动化差异扫描，拦截 API 密钥与数据库连接串。
standard_alignment.how_aligned_en: Combines OWASP Top 10 vulnerability heuristics with Gitleaks secret pattern recognition, intercepting hardcoded credentials and CVE risks in agent PR diffs.

name: License Compliance Audit (apache/magpie)
category_title_en: Can the output be published directly?
timing_desc_en: Pre-release license hygiene: Triggered before open-sourcing or distributing repositories to verify SPDX headers and licenses.
timing_desc_cn: 开源发布前协议审计：在将项目公开发布或分发前，校验开源许可证与 SPDX 文件头合规性。
why_chosen_en: Tackles copyright and copyleft pollution. AI code often mixes incompatible open-source licenses or lacks mandatory attribution notices, creating massive legal exposure under Apache, MIT, and GPL regimes.
why_chosen_cn: 排查 AI 编程中可能引入的开源许可证冲突。由 Apache 软件基金会相关项目开发，自动检查依赖许可证兼容性与声明完整性。

status.adoption: Apache 软件基金会官方项目 (apache/magpie)
status.trust_source: 源自 Apache 软件基金会 Magpie 项目，遵循 Apache 官方知识产权与许可证政策，只读审计不擅自修改代码文件。
status.trust_source_cn: 源自 Apache 软件基金会 Magpie 项目，遵循 Apache 官方知识产权与许可证政策，只读审计不擅自修改代码文件。
status.trust_source_en: From the official Apache Software Foundation Magpie framework, strictly enforcing Apache IP and licensing hygiene policies in read-only audit mode.

target_persona: Open Source Maintainers, Software Authors, Compliance Officers
summary_en: Performs read-only license hygiene audit, verifying LICENSE existence, NOTICE completeness, and SPDX header consistency across source files.
summary_cn: 执行只读开源许可证合规审计，核查 LICENSE 文件、NOTICE 声明完整性以及源码文件中的 SPDX 许可证头一致性。
why_care_cn: AI 在编写代码时可能无意中引用了带有强传染性开源协议（如 GPL/AGPL）的代码片段，若直接混入商业或专有项目中，可能面临版权争议。该技能在发布前排查协议兼容性，指出潜在冲突。
why_care_en: AI-generated code snippets can silently introduce restrictive copyleft licenses (GPL/AGPL) into proprietary code, risking forced open-sourcing or copyright infringement lawsuits. This skill audits license hygiene before public distribution.
how_to_use_cn: 在准备发布代码前运行许可证审计指令，技能自动比对 LICENSE、NOTICE 与源文件头，输出缺失声明或协议冲突的文件清单。
how_to_use_en: Invoke against your repository to produce a grouped license audit report verifying SPDX identifiers and identifying uncredited third-party code.

standard_alignment.name_zh: Linux 基金会 SPDX 软件包数据交换国际标准 (ISO/IEC 5962:2021) 与 Apache 许可证合规规范
standard_alignment.name_en: SPDX (Software Package Data Exchange) ISO/IEC 5962:2021 & Apache Licensing Policy
standard_alignment.organization: Linux Foundation, ISO & Apache Software Foundation
standard_alignment.how_aligned_zh: 参照 ISO/IEC 5962:2021 SPDX 机器可读协议标签与 Apache 软件基金会依赖兼容性分类标准，检查代码库是否存在不兼容协议引用。
standard_alignment.how_aligned_en: Enforces ISO/IEC 5962:2021 SPDX identification and Apache 3rd-party licensing policies, preventing copyleft contamination and uncredited code imports.

name: Agent Sandboxes (disler/agent-sandbox-skill)
category_title_en: What can I feed to AI?
timing_desc_en: Pre-execution isolation: Intercepts high-risk shell, code, and file write actions into isolated E2B microVMs.
timing_desc_cn: 执行前隔离门禁：在智能体执行高危脚本或破坏性命令前，将其限制在隔离沙盒中运行。
why_chosen_en: Directly tackles the critical leap from 'LLM generating bad text' to 'Agent executing dangerous actions'. Enforces strict host OS filesystem isolation by diverting code and shell tasks to ephemeral E2B microVMs.
why_chosen_cn: 针对具备终端与文件操作权限的 Agent 风险，将高危脚本与 Shell 命令重定向至隔离的临时微型虚拟机，保护宿主机系统安全。

status.adoption: GitHub 热门开源技能 (disler/agent-sandbox-skill)
status.trust_source: 遵循 Agent Skills 开放标准，提供沙盒管理命令行工具，将高危命令与文件操作路由至隔离的临时微虚拟机中运行。
status.trust_source_cn: 遵循 Agent Skills 开放标准，提供沙盒管理命令行工具，将高危命令与文件操作路由至隔离的临时微虚拟机中运行。
status.trust_source_en: Conforms to the open SKILL.md specification. Manages ephemeral microVM sandboxes via dedicated CLI to route risky commands off host machines.

target_persona: Software Developers, Data Analysts, Power AI Users
summary_en: Enforces isolated sandbox execution via E2B microVMs for Agent-generated code, binary operations, and destructive CLI tasks, preventing host OS compromise.
summary_cn: 为智能体执行的代码与终端命令提供基于 E2B 的临时虚拟机隔离环境，防止误操作或恶意命令影响宿主机。
why_care_cn: 赋予 Agent 终端与文件写权限后，若遭遇提示词注入或模型理解偏差，可能在本地执行误删文件或修改系统配置的命令。该技能让高危操作在一次性沙盒中执行，即便出错也不会影响本地电脑。
why_care_en: Agentic tools with write and terminal permissions can accidentally overwrite project files or execute malicious instructions injected from untrusted web pages. This skill confines risky operations to disposable microVM sandboxes.
how_to_use_cn: 将技能复制到客户端目录中。在涉及代码执行或测试未知脚本时，命令智能体调用沙盒工具在隔离环境中完成运算与验证。
how_to_use_en: Copy the skill package into your client skills folder. The agent delegates untrusted command execution and code testing to ephemeral sandboxes.

standard_alignment.name_zh: OWASP 智能体应用十大安全风险 (Excessive Agency & Sandbox Isolation) 与 NIST 最小权限原则
standard_alignment.name_en: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications (Excessive Agency Defense) & NIST Principle of Least Privilege
standard_alignment.how_aligned_zh: 针对 OWASP Agentic Top 10 中列出的过度授权与级联破坏风险，落实沙盒隔离措施，将执行操作限制在临时虚拟机边界内。
standard_alignment.how_aligned_en: Implements deterministic isolation controls against OWASP Agentic Top 10 Excessive Agency and cascading failures, restricting agent destructive radius to zero.
